request.style: English, male baritone solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, strings, reverent and tense, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Two hundred soldiers march to Caesarea
Lysias writes the letter with care
Brought safely to Felix the governor
He asks what province Paul endures

[Chorus]
Faith in Christ Jesus he speaks
Righteousness and self control
Judgment to come makes Felix afraid
That is enough for now he says

[Verse]
Five days later Ananias comes
Tertullus lays the charges down
Paul defends himself with cheer
I worship God according to the Way

[Chorus]
Faith in Christ Jesus he speaks
Righteousness and self control
Judgment to come makes Felix afraid
That is enough for now he says

[Verse]
Felix was informed about the Way
He adjourned the hearing that day
Wait for Lysias to come down
Then I will decide your case

[Chorus]
Faith in Christ Jesus he speaks
Righteousness and self control
Judgment to come makes Felix afraid
That is enough for now he says

[Bridge]
Days later Felix and Drusilla
Came to hear what Paul would say
He listened to the faith in Christ
And grew afraid in that place

[Outro]
Hoping for money he sent for him
Left Paul in prison two years more
